text:
sam: Heads up — auditors requested CMK rotation for prod-nodes next Wed 03:00 UTC. Planning window. Need to validate impact on GPU node boot, EBS-encrypted volumes, and VPC flow logs :lock:
kevin: +1. i'll try to repro in staging-gpu first. worried about kubelet mount failures on encrypted PVCs
leo: FYI: if alias keeps pointing to same key material, EBS stays accessible, but AMIs that rewrap at first boot can hit problems. recommend a staging canary before prod
maria: Also ensure CloudTrail records key usage and flow logs for gpu-subnets are delivered to the audit bucket encrypted with the new key. auditors will want proof of delivery :scroll:
sam: Can someone check node IAM policy for kms:Decrypt / ec2:AttachVolume? I think node-role has a wildcard right now
kevin: Confirmed — `aws_iam_role_policy node-role` in terraform has "Resource": "*" for a couple actions. i'll scope it to specific volume and key ARNs and open a PR
anne: Quick note on firewall: rule SN-237 still allows 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp:22 for a short window. We must lock SSH to bastion SG before any key ops that touch nodes :no_entry:
ops-bot: incident created inc-20250112-07 assigned to @kevin, @maria for KMS rotation prep
kevin: Regarding region fallback — if we can't bring up GPUs in us-east-1, fallback to eu-west-1 is blocked: we don't have a matching CMK there. Cross-region key replication isn't enabled. Options: (a) create eu CMK and update node image, (b) use temporary unencrypted staging (not ideal). cost estimate: ~5k one-time + ~800/mo for extra logging/storage
leo: My plan: create an EU CMK, grant node-role decrypt, spin 2 p4 nodes, run boot + perf sanity. If good, include it in runbook. This avoids nasty cross-region KMS surprises
maria: Audit constraints: retain key rotation logs for 2 years. We'll configure CloudTrail -> S3 (SSE-KMS) with lifecycle 2y and object lock for critical records. Example command for bucket encryption:
```
aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket redwood-audit-logs --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"aws:kms","KMSMasterKeyID":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abcd"}}]}'
```
kevin: I'll open PRs for: (1) tighten node IAM, (2) enable KMS rotation on staging key, (3) add VPC flow logs for gpu-subnets -> audit bucket. Target deploy tomorrow 02:00 UTC
sam: Thanks — please tag me and @security on the PRs so we can review the runbook and rollback steps
leo: Quick repro commands I used in staging (copy/paste):
```
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:alias/prod-nodes
# launch a canary p4 instance with the node-role and attach encrypted EBS
aws ec2 attach-volume --volume-id vol-0abc --instance-id i-0def
# check /var/log/cloud-init.log for decryption errors
```
maria: Also confirm S3 bucket ACLs block public access and enable object lock. auditors will flag any missing protections
kevin: PR links when ready: #4123 (IAM tighten), #4124 (flow logs), #4125 (staging rotation). i'll paste links in this thread once opened
sam: Perfect. once PRs merge, let's run the staging canary and hold until we see no mount/decrypt errors. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
